title: audio_export_range
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.11) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_exportAudio + kalam-prd.md §7.1 kalam_exportAudio (Addendum A2: one shared host service), Hush FR-3, FR-4, Kalam FR-3; not routed yet. CEP WNC_AUDIO.exportRange (signed bridge). Export a sequence range's audio to a WAV (48 kHz mono 16-bit, Wave48mono16.epr, exportAsMediaDirect): only the ticked audio tracks are heard (the others are muted for the export and restored after), In/Out are set temporarily and restored.

items.description: track index (0-based, as Premiere's DOM numbers tracks)

audioTracks.description: the ticked audio tracks (Hush FR-3, Kalam FR-3); every other audio track is muted during the export, then restored

extDir.description: Hush passes its extension folder (hush_exportAudio); optional because Kalam's kalam_exportAudio does not

data.description: Union of hush_exportAudio {outPath,start,end,audioTracks,extDir} and kalam_exportAudio {outPath,start,end,audioTracks}; field names as the PRDs write them.

start.description: Kalam's kalam_exportAudio also returns the range start, sequence seconds

readback.description: path: the WAV written (both PRDs); start / end: what kalam_exportAudio returns as well. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.
